title: 第一章 不愧人父第二章 天火渊
content_zh:
江宁城！
天未亮，枝叶霜白。
罗冠准时醒来，稍事洗漱出门。
来到院中，向父亲房间看了一眼，昨日持续到后半夜的咳嗽声，似乎还在耳边。
他脸上浮现愧疚，深吸口气大步流星，进入演武场。
“喝！”
罗冠提起石墩，开始日复一日的身体打熬。
经年累月使用，石墩把手已包浆，边角多有磨损。
它重达百余斤，但在罗冠手上，却有一种灵巧韵味。
很快，罗冠头顶冒出腾腾白气，身上薄衫被汗水浸透，露出线条分明的强健身躯。
两个时辰后，罗冠将石墩放下，大口大口喘息。
双臂、双腿颤抖，酸痛的肌肉如蚯蚓般，不断震颤扭曲。
可胸腹之间，仍是一片沉寂。
罗冠努力站直身体，初阳微红浅淡的光线，洒落在他身上，更添了几分落寞、不甘。
世人修炼，皆自打熬身体为始，至十六岁身躯长成气血充沛，可尝试凝聚通天骨。
成功，便可踏入修行！
这天下，有武道七境。
十力、百夫、千山、万重，冲霄、凌云、踏天。
之后，还有仙途十重。
炼气、筑基、金丹、元婴、神魂、归元合一、无量大劫、一念擎天、永恒不灭，羽化登仙。

罗冠自六岁炼体，十二年风雨无阻。
十六岁初凝通天骨失败。
十七岁再败。
半月前，他第三次尝试，仍是徒劳！
年过十八，体内先天之气逐步溃散，将再无凝聚通天骨的可能，此生注定平凡。
虽说踏入修行大道者，百人中无一，可他是罗家三长老独子，父亲虽因当年重伤不可再动修为，却也曾是千山境高手。
自幼各种灵药进补，身体打熬有父亲指点，旁人耗尽家财不可得的“聚骨机缘”，他更是足有三次。
但，他依旧失败了……
少年人坚毅的嘴角，露出一丝苦涩。
天赋这种东西，有时真的让人绝望！
他曾坚信人定胜天，可结果教会了他，如何接受现实。
老仆看着演武场中的罗冠，眼底露出不忍，行礼道：“少爷，老爷叫您吃早饭。”
罗冠深吸口气，“好。”
待他离去，旁边的小厮嘟囔，“少爷都这样了，还早起干嘛……”
老仆厉喝，“少爷的事，也是你能说的！”
小厮缩缩脖子，“少爷三次聚骨失败，耗费族产无数，嚼舌根的人多了去，我是不想少爷再被嘲笑。”
老仆长叹，“别人说是他们的事，可少爷的努力，咱们都看在眼里！当年那么个小人，天不亮就被老爷拉出来，在寒风里站桩。”
“我还记得，少爷小时候疼的哭，梦里一直喊娘……夫人当年最疼他，如果知道少爷受这么多苦，最终却是这结果，一定心疼坏了。这贼老天可真不长眼，我家少爷怎么就不能修行了……”
content_en:
Jiangning City!
It's still dark, the branches and leaves are white with frost.
Luo Guan woke up on time, took a shower and went out.
When I came to the courtyard, I took a look at my father's room. The coughing sound that lasted into the second half of the night seemed to still be in my ears.
Guilt appeared on his face, he took a deep breath and strode into the martial arts arena.
"Drink!"
Luo Guan lifted up the stone pier and began to exercise day after day.
After years of use, the handles of the stone piers have been coated with pulp and many of the edges and corners are worn.
It weighs more than a hundred kilograms, but in Luo Guan's hands, it has a dexterous charm.
Soon, white steam came out of Luo Guan's head, and his thin shirt was soaked with sweat, revealing his strong and well-defined body.
Two hours later, Luo Guan put the stone pier down and gasped for air.
His arms and legs were shaking, and his sore muscles were shaking and twisting like earthworms.
But there was still silence between his chest and abdomen.
Luo Guan tried his best to stand up straight. The reddish light of the early sun fell on him, making him feel even more lonely and unwilling.
People in the world start practicing by training their bodies. By the time they reach the age of sixteen, their bodies will be full of energy and blood, and they can try to condense the Heavenly Bones.
If you succeed, you can start practicing!
In this world, there are seven realms of martial arts.
Ten powers, hundreds of men, thousands of mountains, ten thousand weights, soaring into the sky, reaching the clouds, and stepping on the sky.
After that, there are ten levels of immortality.
Refining qi, building foundation, golden elixir, Yuanying, divine soul, returning to the origin and becoming one, boundless catastrophes, one thought reaching the sky, eternal immortality, becoming an immortal.
Luo Guan has been practicing physical training since he was six years old, and has been doing it for twelve years regardless of rain or shine.
At the age of sixteen, he failed to condense the Heavenly Bones for the first time.
Defeated again at the age of seventeen.
Half a month ago, he tried for the third time, but it was still in vain!
After reaching the age of eighteen, the innate Qi in the body gradually dissipates, and it is no longer possible to condense the Heavenly Bones, and this life is destined to be ordinary.
Although not one among a hundred people has entered the path of cultivation, he is the only son of the third elder of the Luo family. Although his father was seriously injured and could no longer practice cultivation, he was once a master in the Thousand Mountains Realm.
He has been supplemented with various elixirs since he was a child, and his father has given him guidance on physical exercise. He has even had three "bone-building opportunities" that others would never get if they spent all their wealth.
But, he still failed...
There was a hint of bitterness in the corner of the young man's determined mouth.
Talent is such a thing, sometimes it really makes people despair!
He once firmly believed that man can conquer nature, but the result taught him how to accept reality.
The old servant looked at Luo Guan in the martial arts arena, with unbearable expression in his eyes, and saluted, "Master, I want you to have breakfast."
Luo Guan took a deep breath and said, "Okay."
After he left, the boy next to him muttered, "Young master is like this, why are you getting up so early..."
The old servant shouted sharply, "You can talk about the young master's affairs!"
The young man shrank his neck and said, "The young master failed to gather bones three times, which cost the family a lot of money. There are too many people gossiping. I don't want the young master to be laughed at again."
The old servant sighed, "Others say it's their fault, but we all see the young master's efforts! Back then, such a villain was pulled out by the master before dawn and stood in the cold wind."
"I still remember that the young master cried in pain when he was a child and kept calling me mother in his dreams... My wife loved him the most back then. If I knew that the young master had suffered so much and ended up with this result, she would have been heartbroken. This thief God is really short-sighted. Why can't my young master stop cultivating..."
